entry.title: New: Resolution 518 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 518-26 & GOEAC-121 - 05/20/26
entry.content:
AMENDS THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I BY REPEALING RULE NO. 7 AND ADDING A RULE RELATING TO PERMITTED INTERACTION GROUPS

Replaces ad hoc committees with permitted interaction groups.
